info.name: PowerSchool SIS REST Authentication District API

params.name: pagesize
params.description: Number of records to return per page.

params.name: q
params.description: Filter expression using FIQL-like syntax. Example: id=ge=10000 to filter records with id >= 10000.

params.name: projection
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Omit to return all fields.
